title: Local Smart Home Privacy Walkthrough
oneLiner: Households walk room by room to see which smart-home devices are local, cloud-linked, voice-exposed, or safe for guests.
targetUser: Home Assistant users, privacy-conscious families, and local installers setting up smart homes for nontechnical households.
keyUX: Map rooms and devices, tag local/cloud behavior, test voice aliases, and print a guest-safe privacy walkthrough card.
sourceSignalReferences: S3: GitHub trending shows runnable LLM apps and local-first Home Assistant - https://github.com/trending
S14: Home Assistant privacy/local-control and LLM alias issues - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues
twist: Turns smart-home privacy into a physical walkthrough rather than a settings dashboard.
smallGroupFit: Home Assistant hobbyists can test it during one weekend device audit.
spreadTrigger: The card is useful for family members, house sitters, renters, and installers.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive mobile-first app called "Local Smart Home Privacy Walkthrough" for Home Assistant users auditing smart-home privacy room by room. Show a room device map, local vs cloud tag rail, voice alias test list, guest mode checklist, camera and sensor visibility, offline fallback notes, and printable privacy walkthrough card. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with sturdy mobile controls, room inspection rails, clear local/cloud badges, and practical house-walkthrough pacing.
